description.en: Responsive Tailwind CSS components featuring full right-to-left language support.
description.zh: 支持全套 RTL（从右至左）排版的优雅响应式 Tailwind CSS 组件集合。

content.en: Meraki UI is a curated collection of beautiful, responsive Tailwind CSS components designed with built-in Right-to-Left (RTL) language direction support. Created by Khatab Wedaa, it includes alert bars, cards, navbars, and heroes optimized for global multi-lingual applications.
content.zh: Meraki UI 是一套兼具视觉美感与多语言普适性的开源 Tailwind CSS 组件集。其最大特色在于开箱即支持完整的 RTL（从右至左语言，如阿拉伯语、希伯来语）排版镜像，收录了丰富的警告框、信息卡片、导航栏与 Hero 区块，助力全球化产品出海。
